info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Appeals-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Appeals Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive list of insurance claims appeals. This endpoint enables users to retrieve detailed information about each appeal, including status updates and related data. It is designed for insurance professionals and claims adjusters who need to monitor and manage appeals efficiently. By leveraging this API, users can streamline their processes, enhance transparency, and improve response times regarding claims appeals.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific claims appeal, allowing users to view and manage their appeal status.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the necessary details for processing an appeal regarding claims. It expects a JSON format with the required schema defined to ensure all relevant information is captured accurately.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsAppealsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to claims appeal. The expected input is a JSON string containing the relevant details.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsAppealsResponse.title: Appeal Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the appeal request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result associated with the appeal operation.

state.description: The current state of the appeal request.

processingTimeMs.description: The total time taken to process the appeal request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information regarding the appeal operation.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsAppealsResponse.description: Response structure for the appeal operation, which indicates the status of the request and provides relevant details.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the appeal.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the appeal was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the appeal was created by an automated system.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the auditing of the appeal operation.
